decision.reason: The evidence excerpts [ev-782bc47d120d] and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] contain only "apiVersion: v1", so all we have is the computed diff. That diff says existing ImageRepository objects "stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten" and must be migrated "before a later release removes v1beta2". Nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured in this release, so migration-required claims mandatory work the evidence does not support. Objects work today and only a future removal of v1beta2 would break them, which makes this deprecation (review), not action.
